title: SKU & Limits Migration — Execution Plan and Cross-Functional Coordination
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Execute a coordinated migration from the legacy SKU/limit matrix to the new SKU + tiered limits model with predictable billing, minimal customer friction, and clear sales/partner enablement. Scope includes SKU mappings, backend billing calculations, admin console UI, API compatibility flags, billing communications, release notes, and the sales enablement pack. Out of scope for this ticket: pricing strategy changes outside SKU mapping (handled by PM-19733), enterprise contract renegotiations, and on-prem appliance billing. Constraints: billing pipeline freeze windows (end of month runs), legal review for contract language, and ensuring zero-double-billing during phased cutover. Key decisions to make: grandfathering windows, flag rollout cadence (canary -> staged -> global), and whether to surface per-customer migration toggles in Console or handle server-side only.
acceptance_criteria: All legacy SKUs have one-to-one or coalesced mapping documented and approved by Finance
Billing pipeline produces expected invoice totals for 10 representative accounts (test dataset) with delta <= 0.5%
Console shows new SKU fields for admins and exposes migration status; API backward compatibility preserved for 60 days
Release notes, support playbook, and sales enablement deck approved and uploaded to Drive
Canary group (1% of traffic) rolled for 72 hours with <1% error rate and no billing anomalies
updates: 2025-11-06: Kickoff with Billing Eng, Finance, Legal, Support, and Sales Ops. Agreed on phased migration and need for an automated SKU mapping import. Action: ENG-4199 to add import endpoint.
2025-11-07: Drafted SKU mapping spreadsheet and shared with Finance (Drive: /Shared/PM/PricingModernization/SKU-mappings-v1). Finance requested retention of legacy SKU IDs for 90 days.
2025-11-08: Legal reviewed proposed comms; requested an explicit clause for customers on grandfathered commitments. Added to release notes checklist.
2025-11-09: Design review — Console migration UX prototype accepted with two changes: add ‘preview invoice’ and a migration rollback button. Design artifact: Confluence /design/sku-migration-ux.
2025-11-10: Decided on migration cadence: canary (1%), ramp to 10% after 48 hours, 50% after one week, full after two weeks. Added preflight test suite to ENG-4021.
2025-11-11: Sales enablement outline drafted. Action items: Sales Ops to create account-level migration reports and CS to prepare targeted messaging for impacted enterprise accounts.

2025-11-12: Technical dry run completed in staging. Billing PR gh-4892 created and linked. Found rounding edge case in legacy-to-new mapping; ENG assigned hotfix (ENG-4211). Moving ticket to Planned with owners and timeline.
rollout_steps: Create mapping import and validation job in billing service
Deploy billing changes to staging and run full invoice comparison suite
Enable API compatibility flag (api.v2.sku_migration) for internal canary tenants
Run canary at 1% for 72 hours; monitor invoice deltas and error rates
Ramp to 10% then 50% with 48h observation windows
Open migration scheduling to admins via Console and send proactive emails to impacted customers
Global cutover and deprecation notice for legacy SKU API after 60 days
launch_tasks: PM: finalize SKU mapping and sign-off from Finance and Legal
Engineering: implement import endpoint, billing logic, compatibility flags, and preflight tests
Design: final Console screens, preview invoice UX, rollback button
Docs: release notes, API migration guide, migration FAQ
Support/CS: create support playbook, canned responses, and enterprise outreach lists
Sales: enablement deck, objection handling FAQs, and migration reports for AE dashboards
Marketing/Comms: external customer email schedule, status page templates
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Unexpected invoice deltas for large customers. Mitigation: preflight full-account invoice simulation and CFO sign-off before ramping beyond canary.
Risk: Confusion from customers about changed limits. Mitigation: explicit side-by-side sample invoices in release notes and in-console preview before migration.
Risk: Migration rollout collides with month-end billing. Mitigation: block cutovers during billing-run windows and coordinate with Ops calendar.
Risk: Double-billing due to overlapping flags. Mitigation: add an idempotency token to migration jobs and audit logs; create rollback playbook in Support.
Risk: Sales objections due to perceived price increases. Mitigation: equip Sales with clear mapping doc, value messaging, and account-level delta reports.
